cards.card_text: Into the treasury go 61,000 darics of gold, 5,000 minas of silver and 100 priestly garments.
cards.verse_text: According to their ability, they gave to the treasury for this work 61,000 darics of gold, 5,000 minas of silver, and 100 priestly garments.
